Proposed quick options (all in PT):
- Option A: Tue Aug 10, 10:00–11:30 PT (single 90-min scoping + mini lab)
- Option B: Wed Aug 11, 10:00–10:45 PT (architecture) + Thu Aug 12, 10:00–10:30 PT (hands-on lab)

If you want to keep the original intro, we can keep Aug 11 as-is. Otherwise we’ll update calendar invites and send a merged invite.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
